info.title: ECHOS API
info.description: Decision-support demo API for ECHOS (not a diagnostic tool). **No authentication**: for local demos only, bound to 127.0.0.1. Lists are paginated with `limit` and `offset`. Errors have the shape `{"error": {"status": 404, "message": "..."}}`.

schema.title: Response Statuses Api Patients  Pid  Statuses Get

post.description: Acknowledge an alert (stops the escalation timer). Idempotent.

get.description:
The "I have seen this" link in alert e-mails: signed (HMAC) and expiring, no login. Acknowledges the alert it names (idempotent) and shows a small page
that says nothing about the person. Forged / malformed tokens all get the same answer.

post.description: Mark an alert as handled (closes its open tasks).
Exchange a token for a role. The token is then sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Failed attempts are rate-limited.

get.description: Is authentication on, and which role does this request have? (role is null when not logged in)
Every detector, agent and infrastructure part: what it does, what it must never do, and whether it is running.
The message bus: who told whom what (newest first).

schema.title: Response Agent Messages Api Agents Messages Get

post.description: Resend ONE outbox row now (uses this API's mailer: DryRun unless alerts.send_real). A row that is already SENT is never re-sent (409).

get.description: Server-Sent Events: alert, day_status, report_ready, agent_health, outbox_status. Comment heartbeat every 15 s. Reconnect with Last-Event-ID.

post.description: Fault demo: SIGKILL a worker; the supervisor restarts it. Refused unless config api.allow_kill is true.

get.description: Flags the UI needs: whether agent kill is enabled and whether mail is real (never secrets).

parameters.name: names

schema.description: comma-separated metrics file names (default: the v2_* evaluation files)
schema.title: Names

parameters.description: comma-separated metrics file names (default: the v2_* evaluation files)

get.description: The Review Coordinator's list for a day (latest allocated day if none is given), plus the patients it deferred.

What this person's Patient Monitor saw and concluded, newest day first: readings vs personal usual, urgent / attention flags,
agitation windows with reasons, the personal event rate with its 95% credible interval, and whether the Coordinator picked them.

schema.title: Response Monitor Timeline Api V2 Patients  Pid  Monitor Get

post.description:
A clinician's answer after a review (confirmed problem or not). It goes to the Care agent, which passes it to the patient's Patient
Monitor as FEEDBACK: the monitor updates its personal event rate and episode history from it.

Demo: inject one vitals reading for a replay patient at the current simulated time. The Patient Monitor checks it at once; a red-flag
value (NEWS2 red score, BP >= 180/120) becomes an URGENT alert through the Care agent.

get.description: Counts for the dashboard header: days scored, urgent alerts, reviews (and how many found a confirmed event), messages per topic.

reviewed.title: Reviewed

vitals_event.title: Vitals Event

agitation_windows.title: Agitation Windows

priority.title: Priority
priority.description: max(vitals risk / its base rate, agitation risk / its base rate)

outcome.title: Outcome
